steps.en: The latest mobile number is checked at the data source and saved
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru dicek di sumber data dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup for a newer mobile number is switched off in production, so the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian nomor mobile terbaru dimatikan di produksi, jadi nomor yang tersimpan dipakai.

steps.en: Unique individual offenders are identified and their notices combined in one SMS
steps.id: Offender individu unik diidentifikasi dan notice-nya digabung dalam satu SMS
steps.why_en: Notices are grouped per offender and due date, so some offenders still get several SMSes.
steps.why_id: Notice digabung per offender dan tanggal jatuh tempo, jadi sebagian offender tetap menerima beberapa SMS.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport, no-mobile and company offenders get no SMS
steps.id: Offender opt-out, passport, tanpa mobile, dan perusahaan tidak dikirimi SMS
steps.why_en: The opt-out check is correct but sits in the reminder job that is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan opt-out sudah benar tetapi ada di job reminder yang dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: The SMS lists outstanding notices and refers to the 2nd letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice outstanding dan merujuk ke surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored as data, so it cannot be confirmed that it mentions the 2nd letter.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan tersimpan sebagai data, jadi belum bisa dipastikan menyebut surat ke-2.

steps.en: The SMS is sent to the individual offender in a batch job
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke offender individu lewat batch job
steps.why_en: Sending is switched off in production, so no SMS leaves the system unless settings change.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dimatikan di produksi, jadi tidak ada SMS keluar kecuali pengaturan diubah.
